title: Reporting Subscription State
description: Seller readback for one principal-level reporting subscription (experimental, media_buy.reporting_subscriptions). Per-account coverage and exclusions are read through get_reporting_status subscription_coverage while the caller is authorized; accounts whose authority the caller lost are reported here in accounts_unauthorized, because get_reporting_status treats them as unknown.

state.description: active: accepted and resolving per account. inactive: the caller set active false. action_required: the subscription cannot deliver anywhere until the caller acts, for example because its destination is suspended or not ready; issues names the cause. Moving to action_required fires principal.changed with reason reporting_subscription_changed.

accepted_at.description: When the seller accepted the current subscription_version. Immutable for that version. A buy is covered from the first complete period starting on or after the later of this instant and the buy's confirmed_at.

prior_versions.description: Earlier versions whose obligations are still retained, newest first, so a buyer can recompute their expected periods after local-state loss.

superseded_at.description: The next version's accepted_at. Coverage under this version ends at the first boundary at or after it.

deactivated_at.description: When active false was applied. Present when and only when state is inactive.

destination_ref.description: Destination generation currently bound. Present when and only when the configuration names a destination.

configuration.description: Desired configuration currently associated with this subscription.

issues.description: Structured issues. Messages are untrusted display data.

accounts_unauthorized.description: Accounts this subscription covered whose authority the caller has since lost, so a revoked grant reads differently from a seller that stopped publishing. Only accounts the subscription previously covered appear. Entries carry no current account data and nothing created after unauthorized_at. An entry is removed on re-grant and is otherwise retained for status_retention_days after unauthorized_at. Every addition or removal fires principal.changed with reason reporting_subscription_changed.

unauthorized_at.description: When the caller's authority for the account ended. Nothing is delivered for periods ending after it, including on retries.

last_owed_period_end.description: Last period boundary at or before unauthorized_at: the end of the last period owed before authority ended.

withheld_period_count.description: Owed periods that ended at or before unauthorized_at but were not delivered by then. They are withheld, not missing, and never count as seller delay. If authority returns, they are owed again, due at the re-grant time plus the offering's delivery_sla.

withheld_reporting_obligation_ids.description: Obligations of the withheld periods, when the seller lists them.
